source.title: Inside NVIDIA Groq 3 LPX: The Low-Latency Inference Accelerator for the NVIDIA Vera Rubin Platform
source.table: Table 2. NVIDIA Groq 3 LPX compute tray specifications

fabric_dram.note: Up-to capacity used as an explicit maximum configuration; equal per-chip sharing is a modeling assumption. Legacy lpddr_* field names denote DRAM via fabric expansion logic, not a verified LPDDR generation.

host_dram.note: Recorded as an equal per-chip share for reference only. Host DRAM is excluded from accelerator capacity and transfer calculations.

bandwidth.sharing: Equal one-eighth share per device; do not duplicate tray bandwidth for each chip.
bandwidth.note: Preserved from the repository's existing LPDDR bandwidth assumption. The cited official table does not establish this bandwidth or LPDDR6; it is not an official or measured external-memory specification.

sram.note: Historical binary-capacity convention retained unchanged. This is not an exact conversion of the official 500 MB/chip specification.
